experiment_template.research_question: Does separating durable evidence from exploratory process history remove the task-dependent harm observed with full one-shot state?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycle-boundary presentation.
Any within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, or non-state mechanism change.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells and retains every outcome.

records.falsifier: Evidence-only state loses required recovery information, creates any unsupported fact, fails integrity or completion gates, uses at least as many aggregate model tokens as Round 12 state, or misses the frozen +0.05 paired span-F1 target without file/validity degradation.
records.mechanism: Keep the objective digest, exact receipt-bound source evidence, recovery handles, truncation facts and limitations. Omit the ordered tool-outcome history from the model-facing projection while retaining it in the deterministic ledger for validation and recovery.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: At GLM-5.3-flash 8K recycle boundaries, projecting durable observed evidence without replaying exploratory tool-outcome chronology improves ContextBench continuity because it preserves source grounding while reducing anchoring on failed or superseded search paths.

experiment_template.research_question: Does delta-only state outperform full one-shot state?
stop_conditions: A delta contains an unobserved fact.
A required historical fact becomes unavailable.

records.falsifier: Delta state omits evidence needed after recycling, creates unsupported state, or fails native quality, completion, integrity, or model-token criteria.
records.mechanism: Project only facts added since the prior boundary while retaining objective identity and exact recovery handles.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A receipt-bound delta containing only newly observed facts is sufficient for useful GLM-5.3-flash continuity at 8K with fewer model tokens.

experiment_template.research_question: Does state provide no criterion-complete benefit over no-state control?

records.falsifier: A frozen state treatment clears the native, validity, integrity, and cumulative-token criteria.
records.mechanism: The model can recover observed evidence after recycling, but replaying deterministic facts cannot add the semantic judgment needed to select correct spans.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Deterministic process or evidence state does not reliably improve GLM-5.3-flash ContextBench outcomes at 8K because semantic evidence interpretation is the limiting factor.

selection.reason: Round 12 disproved unconditional full-state benefit and exposed heterogeneous gains and harms. The next controlled question separates durable evidence from exploratory outcome chronology; delta compression and the semantic ceiling remain explicit alternatives.
